name: WordLyrics
author: moshi
description: Word-by-word lyrics for new songs, by themselves: when a song is added to a library folder (downloaded, copied, ripped), the WordLyrics program finds its lyrics and times every word in the background, and writes a .elrc file next to the song. Songs are only read. Needs the WordLyrics program on this computer; the switch below installs it.

settings.label: Time new songs by themselves
settings.description: A song that appears in a library folder gets word-by-word lyrics a moment later. Off: only when you right-click a song and choose "Time the words (WordLyrics)".

settings.label: How hard the computer works
settings.description: A share of what this computer's graphics card can do. One song takes a few seconds at Full; Light is for gaming at the same time.

settings.label: Say when a song is done
WordLyrics folder
settings.description: Leave empty for the usual place: the WordLyrics folder in your user folder.

settings.label: Backup folder
settings.description: WordLyrics keeps a copy of every song before it works on it. Leave empty for the usual place: a "WordLyrics Backups" folder on the drive with the most free space.

settings.label: Install or update WordLyrics
settings.description: Flip this switch (either way). A window checks the installed program, packages and models first; working components are reused. Missing parts download into the folder above (about 1.4 GB for a first setup). For a published update, run the public installer again.

settings.label: Show progress when new songs are timed
settings.description: Opens a small WordLyrics window with the current stage, song count and errors. Closing it keeps the job running.

settings.label: Open progress and last result
settings.description: Flip either way to show the current job or its last result and report.

settings.label: Generate timestamps / choose music folders
settings.description: Flip either way to open WordLyrics. One Noctis folder is selected automatically; with several folders you can select one, several, or all. Choose 1 to generate missing word timestamps.
